content.title: Flat Reconstruction | An Icon Expands into an Archive World
content.summary: Expand a compact icon into characters and a world, increase graphic density through several symbolic scenes, interrupt the flow with a brief state card, then hand recurring color and panel geometry into a held final lockup. This is an evidence variant of the existing flat-reconstruction template.

quick_start.input_format: Compact icon + stable character/color + density increasing module + isolated state pause + geometry lock
quick_start.recommended_input: The copper-colored seed spiral unfolds from a specimen label into a paper greenhouse world, passing through leaf galleries and root high-density modules, briefly stopping at a wordless quarantine rosette, and finally reorganizing into a plant emblem.
required_anchors: Open with one compact flat icon that visibly expands into a larger graphic field.
Keep one character silhouette, palette and panel family stable while the world modules change.
Insert one short isolated status or negative-space state before the ending.
Resolve the recurring palette and panel geometry into a held final lockup after the last character frame hands off.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Expand a compact icon into characters and a world, increase graphic density through several symbolic scenes, interrupt the flow with a brief state card, then hand recurring color and panel geometry into a held final lockup. This is an evidence variant of the existing flat-reconstruction template.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Open with one compact flat icon, expand it into a character-and-world poster system, raise graphic density through several symbolic environment modules, interrupt the density with one short isolated system-status state, then let the last character frame hand off to a held final lockup built from the recurring palette and panel geometry. Do not claim that visually similar objects across modules are the same physical token unless continuity is directly shown.

invariants.rule: Open with one compact flat icon that visibly expands into a larger graphic field.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting at full density removes the expansion hook.

invariants.rule: Keep one character silhouette, palette and panel family stable while the world modules change.
invariants.purpose: Prevents editorial variety from breaking identity.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing every anchor turns the piece into unrelated posters.

invariants.rule: Raise graphic density through at least two symbolically different environment modules.
invariants.purpose: Builds escalation beyond simple background swapping.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeating one corridor cannot create a PV information ladder.

invariants.rule: Insert one short isolated status or negative-space state before the ending.
invariants.purpose: Creates contrast and a readable pause.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuous high density makes the final lockup feel unearned.

invariants.rule: Resolve the recurring palette and panel geometry into a held final lockup after the last character frame hands off.
invariants.purpose: Closes the graphic family without inventing a final character composite.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated title card discards the accumulated visual grammar.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is readable without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: carrier_or_token
slots.constraint: One visible material, prop or symbolic anchor that carries the causal mechanism.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: A sequence of visible, causally ordered changes rather than decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each change without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final state that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of visible-action sounds; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: cyan folder icon, white rabbit and monochrome source character
dream archive, memory diver and erased source titles
magenta door corridor, bed, giant eye and source device slot
the exact source game-PV panels, poster order and final logo
